before.quality_summary: A source run that emitted 56 usable records was labelled error when three detail pages timed out, hiding a valid partial projection from freshness consumers.

candidate.quality_summary: The earliest broken edge is repaired: non-zero parser output with bounded fetch errors is partial, remains usable, and is visibly marked watch/attention without inventing missing values.

provenance.evidence: All 304 projected records retain source evidence; public cards expose the official source route.

schema.evidence: Before and candidate schema digests match; changes add run-state fields without removing public fields.

freshness.evidence: The affected Kazakhstan domestic-support run emitted 56 rows while three detail fetches timed out; it is now honestly represented as partial/watch.

completeness.evidence: Unknowns remain explicit: deadline 78, amount_min 303, amount_max 283, eligibility 252, top-level application_url 304, and funder 133 records absent.

uniqueness.evidence: Fifty URL duplicate excess rows are explained by distinct UNDP/EBRD notices sharing listing pages; eleven same-source normalized-title excess rows were reviewed and not silently merged.

referential.evidence: Opportunity identifiers, source slugs, source URLs, and rendered detail/comparison/preparation routes reconcile in focused API and browser tests.

semantic.evidence: Lifecycle aggregate is closing 72, rolling 57, open 68, closed 93, forecast 14; relevance is labelled as ranking support rather than eligibility confirmation.

reproducibility.evidence: Run classification is derived from parser count plus bounded last_fetch_error and is covered by scheduler, recorder, API, and status tests.

privacy.evidence: The opportunity pipeline is public-only; browser preparation remains localStorage-only and sends no request after an edit in targeted browser acceptance.

consumer_compatibility.evidence: Catalog, status, operator, comparison, preparation, media, and API consumers retain their routes; new fields and partial labels are additive.

mutations.target: scheduler, run recorder, coverage/status/operator projections, and tests
mutations.replay_key: source slug plus scheduler run identifier
mutations.result: partial output is preserved and exposed as watch/attention with a bounded error reason
mutations.rollback: revert the scoped source-run classification commit; no database rows or generated exports were hand-edited

publication.approval: owner approved one guarded release after all gates
publication.public_verification: pending final release identity and browser acceptance

result_receipt.task: audit and repair official-source to public-projection integrity
result_receipt.outcome: earliest run-state defect fixed without downstream data edits or inferred values
result_receipt.freshness: one source remains honestly partial until its next complete upstream cycle
result_receipt.privacy_boundary: public source data only; no applicant data enters this pipeline
result_receipt.limitations: shared listing URLs do not prove duplicate programmes and missing upstream fields are not inferred
result_receipt.next_action: deploy the green candidate and verify a real source cycle plus public coverage projection
